valk_hullmods.bryn_heading: Reduces weapon ordnance cost based on type/size
valk_hullmods.hc_bonus_factor_content:
Valkyrian capital ships always get @[(positive)100%] of the buff.
Depending on the ship size class, those with deployment point cost greater or equal to @[%s] gain the most benefit.
For fighters, those with ordnance point cost greater or equal to @[%s] gain the most benefit.
Deployment/ordnance point costs for non-Valkyrian ships are @[(negative)halved] for the purposes of calculation.
valk_hullmods.hc_bonus_detail_content_battle1: Hard flux dissipation when shields are active +@[(positive)%s]

valk_fearlessTour.bar_s0: A woman bearing the Valkyrian emblem sits by the window, frowning as she looked outside, casting an unusual atmosphere over the bar.
valk_fearlessTour.bar_o0: After thinking for a moment, you approach the Valkyrian officer
valk_fearlessTour.bar_s1:
You attempt to strike up a conversation, noticing the unusual tension in the air. The other party speaks eloquently about the current state of affairs in the sector while subtly sizing you up...

"If I'm not mistaken, you seem to have a considerable fortune, and perhaps even a private fleet."

The discussion begains to turn to the secrets of the Knights of Ludd, anomalous earth-like planets with peculiar scan signatures, and another of the Valkyries' top-secret warships... Their words successfully pique your curiosity.
valk_fearlessTour.bar_o1_1: Show her your various engineering certificates
valk_fearlessTour.bar_o1_2: Boast to her of your seasoned combat skills
valk_fearlessTour.bar_o1_3: Explain to her of your extensive starfaring experience
valk_fearlessTour.bar_o1_leave: Indicate that you do not want to continue the conversation and turn to leave
valk_fearlessTour.bar_s2_0:
"Truth is, I have a special private commission, and I hope to get a reply as soon as possible."

A stack of documents seemingly out of nowhere and is now spread across the table, with contact details and a rough summary written in large, bold letters.
valk_fearlessTour.bar_s2_1: After some conversation, she expresses her admiration for your extensive technical knowledge.
valk_fearlessTour.bar_s2_2: After some conversation, she voices some doubt about your ability to command.
valk_fearlessTour.bar_s2_3: After some conversation, she shows great interest in your adventures.
valk_fearlessTour.bar_o2: "Alright. I'll do it as soon as possible."
valk_fearlessTour.event_end_s0: You found the man. The one she was looking for.
valk_fearlessTour.event_failed_s0: You have failed to meet the Valkyrie's expectations.
valk_fearlessTour.event_otherEnd_s0: According to intel reports, the fleet carrying that man has vanished. Regretfully, you will not be able to meet the intriguing figure.
valk_fearlessTour.event_s0: The Valkyrian officer gave you a bounty dossier. To learn more, you will need to find the one who offered it.
valk_fearlessTour.event_s1: The female Admiral has asked you to deliver three Yoshura-class battleships to her planet's docks within the allotted time.
valk_fearlessTour.event_s1_tip: Please ensure that the ships are mothballed and have no assigned officers.
valk_fearlessTour.event_s1_l2: Go to %s of %s to deliver the battleships
valk_fearlessTour.event_s2_l0: According to the female Admiral, he is at the %s, near %s
